description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named CustomFieldSearchFilterParams, which extends FilterParams. It provides filter parameters for searching custom fields, including properties for 'screen' and 'fieldNumbers', along with related getter and setter methods. It also defines a set of allowed sort fields.

classes.name: CustomFieldSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates filter parameters for custom field searches, including screen and field number filters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the default sort field to 'cf.name'.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen identifier filter, if set.

methods.name: getFieldNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of field numbers filter, if set.

methods.name: setFieldNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of field numbers filter.
